Have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Neverliria Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello! After a long pause I'm finally glad to announce that Neverliria is majorly updated! You can find a checklist of improvements and changes down below.

Changes:

 Added new type of items: Medusa's heads. Can be looted after defeating "Medusa shadows". Heads can be sold in the Travellers camp for coins.
Added 6 new achievements
[olist]
 Chop-Chop!
 Brewmaster
 Coinmaster
 Only Forward
 I See Fire
 Like A Jack
[/olist]
New sound effects
Graphics improvements and cosmetic changes.


Bug fixes:

 Fixed "Like A Perseus" achievement bug. To earn this achievement you need to kill a Medusa shadow.
 Fixed graphic issues with text.
 Small technical improvements.


Thank you for your attention and good luck!

notes.title: Neverliria Update v1.04
notes.content:
Hello! Neverliria updated to version 1.04. Changes list below.
1) Added description of all buildings in the construction menu.
2) Tutorial bug fixed.
3) Other small issues fixed.
4) Small balance improvements.

notes.title: Neverliria Update v1.03
notes.content:
Hello! Here is another update with few more improvements. 
Changelog:
1) Walls rebalance: 
Now walls cannot be destroyed by shadows, but still, shadow warriors will try to attack them (it works as some kind of distraction). Other shadow types can outflank walls as usually.
2) Added a hint when new enemy types going to appear in order to make it easier to prepare your defense in time.
3) Small bug fixes.
Thank you for your bug reports. Have a nice day!

notes.title: Neverliria quick update v1.02
notes.content:
Changelog:
1) Few more icons added to building panel.
2) Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Neverliria Update v1.01
notes.content:
Greetings! Here is the first update of Neverliria with small improvements in balance/hint system and bug fixes.
Changelog:
1. Small resource rebalance. The terrain was replenished with extra stone.
2. Added hint with resources names in the building panel.
3. Some scripts optimized to avoid rare bugs with items seizing.
4. Other small bug fixes.
Thank you for your feedback and bug reports - it helps us to improve Neverlirira and make gameplay process more smooth.

notes.title: Hello, Steam!
notes.content:
Finally, you can find Neverliria on Steam in the section "Coming soon"!
The free demo version of the game will be also available on Steam very soon. While it's preparing, you can download our free demo from resources like:


  Itch 
  Gamejolt
 IndieDB


Thank you and stay with us!
